text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, I don't really know much about 
fashion. But—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't the craftsmanship on this outfit a 
bit rough? The stitching on the sleeves is 
completely uneven..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. It really reflects the 
seamstress's personality. Even so...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Isn't that what makes it so great?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That roughness is something born 
from the land itself, after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A generous climate... Clothes tailored by 
the easygoing people born and raised 
there.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely what gives it this 
unique texture. Being completely neat and 
tidy isn't always the best, you know."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I think that's what gives it 'flavor'! A 
little leeway just expands your horizons, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Having some leeway... broadens one's 
range... I see—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Like this, maybe...? It's far from 
exquisite work... Still—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Fascinating. If durability isn't a 
concern, such a design is entirely 
feasible.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Let's re-examine things once more. The 
way we work, and—our running."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Protect what matters, and discard the 
rest. If only I could do that, I'd be able 
to...!
